value.placement_reason: The printed count 3 and R105,0 establish three holes on a circle concentric with the plate. The face-on layout places one hole on the negative-X centerline and the other two at upper right and lower right. Interpret the circular pattern as 360/count spacing, starting at the established 180-degree axis. The concentric step rims in the main face view and the stepped openings opposite datum A in the side view establish that the counterbores open toward the main-view viewer, the top face.
value.step_conflict_reason: The printed counterbore depth 15,4 mm exceeds the possible 15,0 mm plate thickness, although it fits the possible 25,0 mm thickness. sources.note: The drawing establishes three Ø5,3 through holes on R105,0 with Ø10,0 counterbores 15,4 deep opening from the main-view face. The documented thickness conflict requires conditional omission of the step for the 15,0 reading while retaining the primary holes. Verification: Callout '3 x Ø 5,3 THRU ALL / ⌴ Ø 10,0 ↧ 15,4' gives three through holes, Ø5,3, with Ø10,0 counterbores 15,4 deep. The holes lie on the R105,0 centerline circle centred on the plate centre (0,0). The main view places one hole on the -X horizontal centerline and two at upper right and lower right, symmetric about the X axis. That matches 360/3 spacing starting at 180°, giving 180°, 300° and 60°; no unprinted angle is claimed as printed. Opening face: the main view draws each hole as two solid concentric circles, so the counterbore is visible from the +Z viewer. The side view shows the hidden wide step on the face opposite datum A, consistent with the main view. The isometric face shows the same hole layout, not mirrored, so it is also the +Z face. face='top' is supported. The conflict flag is valid: the printed 15,4 step depth exceeds the 15,0 thickness reading but fits 25,0, while the Ø5,3 through holes are independently established. Every numeric value cites a matching parsed number.

sources.note: The original drawing views establish a compatible circular base body without essential formed or custom-profiled geometry. Verification: The original D-026 sheet shows the face view as a plain circular outline (Ø250,0 callout, D-026/drawing/n/250.0@1-1). It has no lobes, flats, notches or custom contour. The side view is a simple rectangle with parallel faces and uniform width along the whole height. The isometric view shows a flat disc of constant thickness. The only thickness callouts are the stacked printed alternatives 25,0 / 15,0 (D-026/drawing/n/25.0@1-1, D-026/drawing/n/15.0@1-1). The contract explicitly allows printed thickness alternatives, so the body is still a constant-thickness extrusion. The 3x Ø5,3 THRU ALL counterbored holes on R105,0 are cut features. The capabilities state that cut changes do not expand the base-body contract, so they do not stop routing. No bends, steps, grooves or assembled geometry appear. This matches the supported circle outline with supported=true, constant_thickness=true and outline_exact=true. Leaving essential_uncertainty empty is justified.

display.message: Waiting for review: invalid. The original drawing D-026 supports the proposed eligibility object. In the face-on main view, a single circular outer outline carries the leader dimension Ø250,0 (D-026/drawing/n/250.0@1-1). It has no notches, lobes or other outer contours, and the isometric view shows a plain flat disc, so a circle outline is exact rather than a bounding substitute. In the side view, the thickness dimension's extension lines and arrows sit on the two faces of the plate. That dimension prints stacked 25,0 / 15,0 (D-026/drawing/n/25.0@1-1, D-026/drawing/n/15.0@1-1) with no tolerance or limit label, so keeping them as unselected constant-thickness options follows the possible-reading contract. Datum A and the parallelism frame confirm a planar plate. The callout '3 x Ø 5,3 THRU ALL' with counterbore Ø 10,0, depth 15,4 (D-026/drawing/callout/p1-2, n/3.0@1-1, n/5.3@1-1, n/10.0@1-1, n/15.4@1-1) gives through-holes on the R105,0 circle (n/105.0@1-1). For the 15,0 reading, the 15,4 counterbore depth is larger than the thickness, which is an actual printed conflict. Treating that step as a conditional omission for that reading, while keeping the primary through-holes, does not affect whether the body is eligible. The unspecified deburr/edge-break note (D-026/drawing/general/edge_finish) is correctly left out of the model as a minor detail. supported=true, constant_thickness=true and outline_exact=true all follow from the original views. This decision accepts body eligibility only. It does not verify hole angular placement or the counterbore opening face, which belong to the features keys.
